Here is the result of "fetch" for the Page with URL https://app.notion.com/p/3f74c57a590c8128b936d7491884ffb7 as of 2026-10-12T02:17:35.941Z: {"title":"FC-01 Shape/2 Triangle Semantic Compatibility Authority v0.1 — CURRENT / P23 Accepted"} {"type":"emoji","emoji":"🔺"} > **P23 ACCEPTANCE RECORD LINK — 2026-10-12:** ; execution owner . This page is the Current **new Shape/2 semantic scope** only, not a rewrite of V1 historical tuples. GitHub repo-local Authority materialization remains a separately reviewed prerequisite to FC-01 P31. > **CURRENT POST-V1 SEMANTIC AUTHORITY — FC-01 SHAPE/2 TRIANGLE v0.1 — P23 ACCEPTED (2026-10-12).** Scope: only the new `semantic:axiom/shape-content-version2-triangle` tuple, its geometry and operation/snapshot compatibility. This is additive and version-scoped. **Frozen V1 Shape/Object/Operation IDs and V1 negative Goldens remain authoritative for their historical version.** It is not a repo-local `.aegis` transition, product implementation, P31 or P34 verdict. ## 0. Accepted basis, source classification and authority scope - Accepted decision basis: ; detailed upstream designs and . - Frozen predecessors: ; ; ; ; ; ; ; ; . - `authority_id: fc01-shape-triangle-semantic-v0.1`; `scope: semantic:axiom/shape-content-version2-triangle`; `kind: semantic-schema-compatibility`; `status: Current` **only for the versioned extension**. It adds an accepted successor tuple without changing frozen V1 semantics or marking V1 historical readers invalid. - Exact implementation baseline (not currently implementing Triangle): `github:Mostorm-Labs/axiom@2942c63b375366ed977b834aa0a48fe2fb551c6e`. V1 registry and code currently reject Shape/2, as expected before authorized implementation. ## 1. Versioned ObjectKind/ShapeKind acceptance
ObjectKind kind_version shape_kind Accepted reader semantics
Shape=1 1 1 RECTANGLE Original V1 ACCEPT; unchanged historical geometry and canonical bytes
Shape=1 1 2 ELLIPSE Original V1 ACCEPT; circle is Ellipse with equal W/H
Shape=1 2 3 TRIANGLE **New P23 ACCEPTED tuple**; existing ShapeContent fields and versioned geometry
Shape=1 1 3 REJECT; original `SH-G06` remains negative
Shape=1 2 0,1,2,4+ REJECT; no Shape/2 alias or future kind allocations
Shape=1 0 or 3+ any REJECT; no speculative version admission
Connector=7 1 N/A Existing Connector version1, including FreePoint Line/Arrow; no new ShapeKind
- These are **joint exact triples**: `ObjectRecord.kind_id`, `kind_version`, `content.oneof=shape`, `ShapeContent.shape_kind`. Register Triangle only through a separately versioned registry/semantic sidecar; **do not edit historical ****`*_registry_v1.yaml`**** semantics**. - A version-aware reader may accept the union of frozen old tuples and this new tuple; a V1-only reader must reject the new tuple atomically before canonical mutation. No unknown type fallback to Rectangle, Ellipse, VectorPath, placeholder or hidden delete-recreate conversion. ## 2. Triangle geometry, content and appearance - Canonical `ShapeContent{shape_kind,width,height}` stays three existing fields. Width/height are explicit present finite f64 Document Units, strictly \>0; no negative-size clamp, implicit default, kind mutation, vertex array, path bytes, new Protobuf tag or new ObjectKind. - In local X-right/Y-down coordinates the base box is `[0,W]×[0,H]`; closed polygon vertices exactly `A=(W/2,0)`, `B=(W,H)`, `C=(0,H)`, `A`. All fill/outline/HitTest/derived Scene bounds and renderer paths represent this geometry; object rotation/reflection uses existing Transform2D only. - BBox center `(W/2,H/2)` is the FC-01 Snap reference; geometric centroid `(W/2,2H/3)` is not introduced as a new snap feature. Style and locked/visible/opacity remain frozen Field Registry values and default-equivalence rules. - **Explicit exclusion:** selected-object ShapeKind conversion, `SetShapeKind`, ReplaceShapeContent, or DeleteObjects+InsertObjects fake conversion are not accepted. ## 3. Operation / Envelope / validation acceptance - The existing **15 Operation kinds** remain unchanged. New Shape/2 creation uses existing `InsertObjects`; restoration uses `RestoreObjects`; edits reuse `SetTransforms`, `SetObjectSize`, `PatchProperties`, `SetPlacements`, `DeleteObjects` as applicable. - For Shape/2-bearing operations **accept only existing ****`Operation.schema_version=1, payload_version=1`** except historical separate Brush-v2 rules for actual Brush payloads. No generic envelope/schema upgrade is authorized. The Shape/2 tuple is the semantic subtype/version signal. - The existing Brush-v2 `payload_version=2` exception remains exact and independent; Triangle alone cannot qualify a payloadVersion2 operation. V1 `Shape/1,shapeKind3` remains reject regardless of envelope number. - Full structural + semantic version + reference/state validation must occur before every typed or decoded Operation apply, including Snapshot/Replay/remote sync, and must reject whole batches without partial ChangeSet, semantic-generation or history update. A typed apply path is not evidence of validation by itself. - All canonical ID, idempotency and Restore current-absence rules remain frozen. History inverse uses existing operations with new OperationIds, same original ObjectIds where restored, and current-state safety checks. ## 4. Snapshot / mixed-version compatibility
Container or client Shape/2-aware reader Old V1 reader / invariant
Snapshot schema_version=1 containing only V1 objects ACCEPT unchanged ACCEPT unchanged
Snapshot schema_version=2 containing pre-existing Brush-v2/Shape1 objects ACCEPT unchanged Preserve old supported v2 behavior; v2 label never implies Triangle support
Snapshot schema_version=2 containing `(Shape/2,3)` ACCEPT after capability check + whole-snapshot validation REJECT unsupported subtype before apply/re-encoding
Snapshot schema_version=1 containing `(Shape/2,3)` REJECT tuple/container version mismatch REJECT
Operation schema1/payload1 Insert or Restore of Shape/2 ACCEPT with strict versioned structural+state validation REJECT before semantic mutation
Replay or Undo/Redo on Triangle Use same schema and current-state staging; preserve ObjectId, geometry and style No partial/skipped replay or lossy fallback
- Snapshot v2 is the **minimum** permitted container for Triangle; it is not sufficient evidence of reader capability. Snapshot encode/decode/bootstrap and Replay continuation must apply joint version/capability checks. Existing Brush-v2 snapshot semantics must not change. - An unsupported participant must **refuse writable Triangle editing or lossless reserialization**; safe refusal is required. A read-only legacy viewer is optional only after a separate proven lossless policy; no silent downgrading. Exact host/collaboration handshake and lifecycle fences belong to P14–P17. ## 5. Specialized boundaries and unaffected authorities - V1 Connector freepoint straight Line/Arrow uses ObjectKind Connector/1 and unchanged properties; Triangle Shape/2 is **not an AttachedEndpoint eligible target in FC-01**. Future FC-06 defines legal triangle perimeter/port attachment and routing if needed. - Existing `locked` is a canonical editor-control PropertyBag field, **not** a parser-level write prohibition or global cross-client security guard. Editing policy and public Facade gating must be truthful; Unlock must remain possible. - FC-01 Resize scope: handles commit one `SetTransforms`; numeric local W/H editing commits one `SetObjectSize`. Combined intrinsic W/H+Transform atomic anchor preservation is **deferred**; no 16th Operation, no two-Op fake atomicity. - P20 must retain original V1 SH-G01..18 including `SH-G06` REJECT, add SH2-G01..25 candidate fixtures, whole-batch failure, canonical codec/Golden, live sync unsupported-client refusal, typed Replay rejection and snapshot v1/v2 compatibility. These are future proof obligations, not executed tests. ## 6. P23 acceptance identity / materialization hold ```yaml id: fc01-shape-triangle-semantic-v0.1 status: Current scope: semantic:axiom/shape-content-version2-triangle kind: semantic-schema-compatibility version: v0.1 accepted_by_stage: FC-01/P23 accepted_triangle_tuple: [1,2,3] operation_envelope: [1,1] snapshot_min_schema_version: 2 new_operation_kind: false shape_kind_mutation: forbidden v1_semantics_unchanged: true repo_local_materialization: PENDING fc01_p31_p32: NOT_AUTHORIZED ``` - **P23 grants semantic design/implementation-contract Authority only**, not repository source mutation, repo-local `.aegis/authorities.json` materialization, existing Gate changes, P31 authorization, P32 execution, FC-01-DEV or FC-13 physical PASS. Repo-local binding and independent state control review are required before P31.
